statutory_bases.statute: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
statutory_bases.mandate: Strict prohibition on publishing or revealing identity, address, school, or relatives of child victim in any media or database.
statutory_bases.enforcement_action: Mandatory redactive anonymization or ingestion block.

statutory_bases.statute: Indian Penal Code 1860 / Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023
statutory_bases.mandate: Cognizable offence to print or publish the name or any matter making known identity of victim of rape or sexual assault.

statutory_bases.statute: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
statutory_bases.mandate: Prohibition of disclosure of name, address, school or particulars leading to identification of any child in conflict with law or child in need of care.
In-camera proceedings upon request of either party or court discretion; matrimonial disputes shielded from open publication.
Absolute bar on handling or publishing classified defence, strategic, or intelligence judicial proceedings.
